prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: intermediate frame for a photorealistic scroll-driven PC assembly sequence on a website
Input images: Image 1 is the sole edit target and absolute visual anchor.
Primary request: Create the next assembly stage of this exact gaming PC. Keep the exact same black chassis, exact camera position and three-quarter perspective, framing, scale, canvas proportions, black studio background, floor contact, shadow, yellow accent light, materials, and overall photographic treatment pixel-close to Image 1. Inside the chassis, keep the motherboard, CPU, exactly two vertical RAM sticks, the square CPU liquid-cooling pump/block, its correctly routed two black coolant tubes, and exactly two vertically stacked rear/radiator fans installed in the same correct physical positions as Image 1. These parts must look mechanically mounted, not floating.
Required removals: remove the graphics card completely, remove all visible power cables and cable bundles, and remove the glass side panel. Keep the empty PCIe/GPU area clean and physically plausible. Do not add any loose components.
Style/medium: premium photorealistic studio product photography, real PC hardware, physically accurate geometry and mounting points.
Composition/framing: preserve the exact 1122 x 1402 portrait composition and object registration of Image 1; do not crop, zoom, rotate, shift, or redesign the chassis.
Lighting/mood: preserve the original restrained black-and-yellow lighting and reflections, with the same yellow rings on the two installed fans and pump accent as Image 1.
Constraints: change only the installed-component state described above; preserve every exterior case edge, foot, front panel, vent, floor shadow and background. No glass panel. No GPU. No visible power cables or cable bundles. No text, labels, logos, watermark, extra parts, floating parts, or exploded-view layout. This must look like a real photograph of the same PC at the cooling-installed stage, not a concept render.
conversion: ffmpeg 8.1.2 libwebp; quality 92; compression_level 6; preset picture; yuv420p
